info.title: NetSentry API
info.description: Versioned account, workspace, device consent/health, monitoring/report/alert, agent/remote-command and detailed Android event-history APIs. Technical capability does not grant consent or control. Platform source, API integration and actual device validation are tracked separately. POST endpoints retain 201 defaults; direct legacy device registration is disabled.

servers.description: Local default; deployment prefix/base URL is configurable.

post.description: Direct registration is disabled. Use one-time code issuance and /devices/enrol. Existing records remain UNVERIFIED until explicitly enrolled.

delete.summary: Withdraw your own device sharing independently of profile grants

patch.summary: Assign or clear an observed network device department

get.summary: Database and migration readiness without internal details

billingSignature.name: x-billing-signature
billingSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + dot + exact request bytes; separate secret and timestamp header, sandbox only.

quality.description: Threshold source quality. Defaults to measured; estimated is a separate explicit rule and is never summed with measured.
